hardware_limits.comment: Absolute servo range. NEVER command within 200 units of these - end-stop stall risk.

GRIP.comment: LeArm gripper valid range is 1500..2500 -- NOT 500..2500. Reference lib: `case LeArm: if(servo==1) return clamp(value,1500,2500)`. Lower raw = MORE OPEN; 1500 is the open mechanical stop. Commanding 700 drove past it and splayed the jaws = the 2026-07-28 stall. Band keeps 100 clear of 1500 and 200 clear of 2500.

WRIST_ROLL.comment: PROVISIONAL conservative band (center +/-300). NOT calibrated. Widen only after hand-teaching the real mechanical limits with torque off.

safety.comment: Controller does not answer CMD_MULT_SERVO_POS_READ -> NO position feedback, motion is open loop and stalls cannot be detected by reading position. Therefore limits must stay conservative, every servo must be unloaded (torque off) shortly after each move (hold_ms) and on any idle period (idle_unload_ms), and a hard continuous-torque cap (max_continuous_torque_ms) forces an unload no matter what.
safety.gripper_note: NEVER command servo 1 (GRIP) below 1500 under any circumstance -- this is documentation only. The real enforcement is the hardcoded ELECTRICAL_LIMITS[1] floor in robohand/config.py, which cannot be widened by editing this file. robohand.config raises at import time if this value and the hardcoded one disagree.

vision.roi_comment: Fractional [x, y, w, h] = [0,0,1.0,1.0] = the WHOLE 1280x720 frame, no cropping (guard._resolve_roi treats values in (0,1] as frame fractions, so this maps to x=0,y=0,w=1280,h=720). The camera mount was improved and now frames the ENTIRE arm -- base, all links, and the gripper -- well lit; full-frame raw-absdiff is now sufficient on its own (no-motion noise 454/577 changed px vs SHOULDER_PAN 78,116 = 135x, GRIP 25,746 = 45x; see docs/verification-camera.md 'Full-arm-in-frame measurement'). A narrower ROI (e.g. one excluding room background) remains available via `robohand camera-check --roi X Y W H` and would further widen the GRIP margin, but is NOT required for correct operation and is NOT the shipped default -- the full-frame numbers already comfortably clear the gate. If the camera or arm mount is ever moved again, re-measure the ROI and thresholds with `robohand camera-check`. Values >1 are absolute pixels; values in (0,1] are fractions of the frame. The obsolete narrow dark-corner-only ROI was [0,300,520,420].
vision.min_changed_pixels_comment: Site-specific for THIS arm+camera in the NEW full-arm-in-frame setup. 3000 sits ~5.2x above the worst observed no-motion sample (577 changed px, full-frame raw absdiff, 20-warmup/8-flush protocol matching camera.py) and ~8.6x below the worst-case real motion signal (GRIP, 25,746 changed px -- the joint with the smallest visual signature and the one damaged in the original incident). It sits close to the geometric mean of the two (sqrt(577*25746) ~= 3,854), comfortably separated from both noise and the weakest real signal on a log scale. diff_threshold=25 matches the operator's absdiff>25 protocol. robohand/config.py's generic fallback stays at 150 for OTHER unmeasured deployments -- only this live config carries the measured value.
vision.health_comment: Camera-health gate (robohand/camera_health.py). health_interval_s (0.8) and health_frames (15) validated in a prior round (spans more of any auto-exposure hunting cycle; surfaces a higher, more honest noise floor). health_margin (1.5): required = 1.5 * 577 ~= 865.5, comfortably below the 3000 threshold (a further ~3.5x buffer beyond the bare minimum) -- so the default config PASSES comfortably in the new good setup while still rejecting a genuine exposure-hunting/dark-scene regression (any noise floor above ~3000/1.5 ~= 2000 makes required exceed 3000 -> FAIL). health_separation (3.0): floor = 3 * 577 ~= 1731; GRIP's real motion (25,746) clears it by ~14.9x, so the visibility check also passes comfortably. See docs/verification-camera.md 'Full-arm-in-frame measurement'.

gripper.comment: Hard backstops for the incremental grip ladder -- deliberately identical to GRIP's configured min/max above, never crossed regardless of what the vision guard reports. Lower raw = MORE OPEN for this servo, so the ladder closes by increasing toward grip_max_safe and opens by decreasing toward grip_min_safe. grip_min_safe (1600) still stays 100 clear of the true 1500 mechanical/electrical floor.
